facility.name: Children's Lighthouse - Little Elm
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 3001 WOODLAKE PKWY, LITTLE ELM, TX, 75068

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One caregiver's CPR and First Aid certification had expired as of March 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: One caregiver was observed using her cellphone during operating hours to discuss personal matters. This issue was corrected during the inspection after the caregiver was informed of the policy regarding cellphone use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One child with a physician documented food allergy had an emergency plan on file; however, the required medication (EpiPen) was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four out of ten caregivers did not have documented training in the handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver in the 2 and 3 year old classroom was alone with a group of children during naptime. The conditions of the background check were not followed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food: It was observed that apples and taquitos in the fridge were not covered. This was corrected during the inspection when the cook covered the food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food (26 TAC §746.3317(8))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of ten children did not have an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - Infant Birth to 12 Months: Two caregivers stated that they do not take the infants outside at least twice a day. The daily schedule does not include designated times for outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - Infant Birth to 12 Months (26 TAC §746.2206(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The soccer net on the soccer field was found to be in poor condition and torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One out of ten feeding instructions was not updated and expired on July 2, 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection has been expired since 03/24/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During the inspection, I observed a child playing a game on his tablet for over one hour. It was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The  operation allowed one caregiver  to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding her eligibility. The operation immediately removed the caregiver from the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information obtained during an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver yelled at the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information obtained during an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver didn't demonstrated good judgement when she permitted children to pick up food from the ground and consume it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: The operation did not conduct a CO detector test for the following months:  May, June and July.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials: The documentation provided by the manufacturer, detailing the material's impact rating as well as the requirements for installation and maintenance, was not accessible for assessment during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials (26 TAC §746.4913)

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The operation did not conduct a smoke detector testing for the following months: February, March, April, May, June, and July.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The operation did not conduct a fire extinguisher inspection for the month of July/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: It was determined that a caregiver did not adequately supervise children while using the outside play structure. The caregiver did not redirect the children while using the play structure equipment inappropriately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Ten staff files were observed and missing the following; Two staff files are missing how the staff qualify as a caregiver,  One staff files are missing that the staff have signed off on receiving the personnel policies, and  One staff file is missing orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: Two childrens files are missing hearing and vision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The director did not use good judgment as medication was administered to a child twice despite the medication log being up to date, and the child making a comment that medication was being administered again.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: During the investigation, it was determined that two staff did not have training certificates for administering medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregiver: Management did not communicate with each other to let each other know a child had already received medication, resulting in a child receiving medication twice in a day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregiver (26 TAC §746.1203(11))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: Documentation obtained from the operation, determined that diaper changes were not done for a child for approximately 5 hours. This resulted in a diaper rash.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: On the playground three toy riding cars were observed with broken wheels. This was corrected at inspection by having the toy cars be removed from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Staff did not use good judgment when not following the sign in and out procedures for children in their care.   Three classrooms were observed not following the procedures for transferring children in and out of the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Staff did not use good judgment when not following the sign in and out procedures for children in their care. Children are not being transferred to the correct classrooms when they are not in their assigned room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One staff file was observed and is incomplete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Ones child's file was observed and is missing a health statement signed by the physician and immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: During transition from one classroom to another, one caregiver did not know which children they were responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: A caregiver used inappropriate discipline by grabbing a child's arm after providing instructions to go to the carpet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Staff did not use good judgment when not following the sign in and out procedures for children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing: During the investigation inspection, the opening classroom was observed with 1 caregiver and 19 children ranging from 18 months to 5 years old for more than 45 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing (26 TAC §746.1615)

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Staff are not following the nap charts that are created in the classrooms and nap charts have not been updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The operation has not followed through with the plan in place for the nap cots. During the inspection it was observed that nap charts are not being followed and staff were working on the nap charts at the time of the walkthough.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The children's nap cots in the classrooms were labeled with numbers, but the number charts assigned to the children are not being followed, the charts are not updated, and some classrooms do not have a number chart where the children are not receiving the same cots everyday.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the open field playground, there are two boxes in the ground without covers and have wires in the boxes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
